title: seeFinancialData OFF strips pricing from PDF endpoints (LinesDetailProvider path)
custom_preconds:
1. A build with the CRP-BE-09 See-Financial-Data enforcement chokepoint deployed (task SV-7484 — both the serializer-group masking and the PDF-path stripper). This shipped under epic SV-7388.
2. A test user whose role has the “See Financial Data” permission turned OFF (set on the role in Settings → Roles & Permissions → the role → the “See Financial Data” toggle off).
3. A work order that carries pricing — part sell prices, labour rates, and a total — so that a build WITHOUT the stripper would show money on its PDF.
custom_steps:
1. Authenticate as the See-Financial-Data-OFF test user.
2. Request the work order’s PDF from its download endpoint — the shop-app “Print” / “Download PDF” action on a Work Order, which is the PDF-controller / LinesDetailProvider path that CRP-BE-09 added the pricing stripper to (SV-7484). The exact URL is confirmed at build-verification against the running build.
3. Open the downloaded PDF and read its full text.
4. Search the PDF text for any money — dollar amounts, labour rates, part costs, or margin figures.
custom_expected:
1. The PDF renders with no pricing of any kind: no dollar amounts, no rate columns, no part costs, no margins.
2. The text search in step 4 returns no monetary hits.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-7388 (Custom Roles and Permissions), story SV-7523 (Permission: See Financial Data — “OFF: all financial data hidden across every page”) and task SV-7484 ([CRP-BE-09] seeFinancialData enforcement chokepoint — acceptance: a Fin-OFF user gets payloads with no sellPrice/cost/margin keys, including the PDF paths), read on 10 September 2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
